a.lede: When we published our review of the iPhone Duo, I got a lot of hopeful questions from my fellow Mini fans who took note of the cover screen's Mini-ish 5.4-inch size. "Is this… a small phone that turns into a tablet?" they asked. And I'm sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but no. […]
a.title: No, the iPhone Duo isn’t a small phone

b.lede: A small number of early adopters of the much-hyped new foldable phone from Apple have complained of screens cracking.
b.title: Uh-oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it
